description: The project author publishes a Google Earth Engine script estimating populations on flood-prone low-lying land in Dakar, Managua and Ulsan. Zenodo archives version 1.0 under CC BY 4.0; the linked GitHub README states MIT terms for code, although no licence file was found at the tag. The script combines Copernicus terrain, JRC surface water, ESA land cover and GHSL population. Five threshold and radius configurations test rank stability. These calculations can screen city exposure before infrastructure flood-risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code. Coverage is three test cities and one terrain-proximity method. The depositor states that absolute exposed shares vary sharply with thresholds and that the method misses slope-driven runoff, especially in Managua. It is not a hydraulic inundation model. No Earth Engine job was run or exposure value independently checked.
